text:
Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! I'm sorry to hear you're thinking of leaving, but I'm happy to explain how it works.

**What happens to Plant Club when you delete your account**
- Deleting your account cancels your subscriptions.
- Deletion takes up to 30 days to complete.
- Plant Club has no cancellation fee or minimum term.

**My suggestion: cancel Plant Club first**
I can't say exactly when during those 30 days the subscription is cancelled. To be safe, cancel it yourself first:
- Go to "Account" > "Subscriptions" and choose cancel.
- Plant Club is charged on the 25th of the previous month. Changes made before **October 25** affect your next box, so cancelling before then means you won't be billed for November's box.
- Changes made on or after the 25th apply to the following month's box, so one more charge could go through.

**About a box you've already been billed for**
A box that has already been billed is not refunded when you cancel, and it is still sent. Boxes ship in the first full week of the month. If you were billed on September 25, your October box is likely on its way. It also keeps the normal 30-day Plant Care Guarantee.

If you'd rather keep the account but stop the plants, you can also pause for up to 3 months or skip a month from the same "Subscriptions" page.

My knowledge base doesn't cover what happens to things like store credit or open orders when an account is deleted. If you have any, I can escalate so a Support Lead can confirm before you delete.

You can find the delete option under "Account" > "Privacy". Is there anything else I can help with? You're always welcome back at Leafy. 🌿
